author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸುಳ್ಳು ಸಕ್ಕರೆಯಾಗಿ ಸತ್ಯ ಕಹಿಯಿರಲಾಗ
ಮುಳ್ಳುಹಾಸಾಗುವುದು ಜೀವನದ ದಾರಿ
ಪೊಳ್ಳುನಟನೆಯ ಬದುಕು ತೊಡಕಾಗಿ ಪರಿಣಮಿಸೆ
ಕಳ್ಳತನ ತೊರೆಯೊನೀ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When lies are sugar and truth is bitter,
the road of life becomes a bed of thorns;
as a hollow, play-acted life turns into a tangle,
give up the thieving, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Sweet lies make the road thorny in the end. A life of pretence becomes a trap. Let go of deceit.
